paragraphs.zh: 图14为实施例9中制备的式(VIII)化合物的¹³CNMR谱图。
paragraphs.en: Figure 14 is the 13C NMR spectrum of the compound of formula (VIII) prepared in Example 9.
paragraphs.notes: The 13 in 13CNMR is printed as a superscript before C.

paragraphs.zh: 图15为实施例10中制备的环磺酮化合物的¹HNMR谱图。
paragraphs.en: Figure 15 is the 1H NMR spectrum of the tembotrione compound prepared in Example 10.
paragraphs.notes: 环磺酮 translated literally as "cyclic sulfone ketone"; it is most likely the agrochemical common name tembotrione/sulcotrione family term, but nothing on this page determines that. English rendering corrected during the run: the vision pass wrote 'cyclic sulfone ketone' for 环磺酮. 环磺酮 is the Chinese common name of tembotrione; sulcotrione is 磺草酮, a different registered triketone herbicide, and 'cyclic sulfone ketone' is a character gloss that names no compound. The Chinese is unchanged and is authoritative. See NOTES.md.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明一方面提供如下式(A)所示的新化合物：
paragraphs.en: In one aspect the present invention provides a new compound of the following formula (A):

paragraphs.zh: 式中，R₁和R₂为以下任意一项：
paragraphs.en: In the formula, R1 and R2 are any one of the following:
R1 is CF3-CH2-O-CH2-, and R2 is CH3-SO2-;
R1 is Br-CH2-, and R2 is CH3-SO2-;
R1 is CH3-, and R2 is CH3-SO2-;
R1 is CH3-, and R2 is CH3-S-.

paragraphs.zh: 式(A)所示化合物具体包括如下式(I)-(IV)的化合物：
paragraphs.en: The compound of formula (A) specifically includes the compounds of the following formulae (I)-(IV):

paragraphs.zh: 本发明的式(I)化合物可以通过如下路线制备：
paragraphs.en: The compound of formula (I) of the present invention can be prepared by the following route:

paragraphs.zh: 在具体实施方式中，上述路线以式(VI)化合物和溴素为原料，如下进行，但不限于此。
paragraphs.en: In a specific embodiment, the above route uses the compound of formula (VI) and bromine as starting materials, and is carried out as follows, but is not limited thereto.
paragraphs.notes: 溴素 is the Chinese term for elemental bromine (Br2).

structures.position_in_drawing: 1st, sole structure, labelled (A) to its right
structures.drawing_notes: Br is on the upper-left vertex, Cl on the top vertex, R1 on the upper-right vertex, R2 on the lower-right vertex. Four contiguous substituted positions; the two remaining ring vertices (lower-left and bottom) bear no label. Numbering above is as-drawn adjacency, not IUPAC locants. SMILES null because R1 and R2 are variables.

discrepancies.what: Paragraphs [0049]-[0052] list the R1/R2 pairs in the reverse of the order the corresponding structures are drawn after [0053].
discrepancies.drawing_says: (I) = CH3 + SCH3, (II) = CH3 + SO2CH3, (III) = CH2Br + SO2CH3, (IV) = CH2OCH2CF3 + SO2CH3
discrepancies.text_says: [0049] CF3CH2OCH2 + CH3SO2 (matches IV), [0050] BrCH2 + CH3SO2 (matches III), [0051] CH3 + CH3SO2 (matches II), [0052] CH3 + CH3S (matches I)

discrepancies.what: The [0054] scheme arrow carries no reagent at all, while the sentence it illustrates says only 'can be prepared by the following route'. The reagent appears only in the repeated scheme under [0055].
discrepancies.drawing_says: bare arrow from 式（VI） to 式（I）
discrepancies.text_says: [0055] names 式(VI) and 溴素 (bromine) as the starting materials

discrepancies.what: The position of the newly introduced Br in formula (I) is fixed only by the drawing; the prose never states which ring position is brominated.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Br enters the ring vertex adjacent to Cl and para to SCH3 (the upper-left vertex, previously unsubstituted)
